newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tsang says supply solution to HK property shortage.
newsitem.headline: Tsang says supply solution to HK property shortage.

text.p: Hong Kong's Financial Secretary Donald Tsang said on Wednesday the answer to the territory's property shortage was to supply more land.

Speaking to Reuters in an interview, Tsang said that because Hong Kong is small geographically and boasts healthy economic growth, "whether we like it or not the demand for property will grow and prices might rise too".
"The real solution to it is to supply more land and that means cutting some hills, doing more reclamation and growing more high rises in some areas," he said.
Tsang said he hoped the community would get involved in deciding where more development should occur.
"We have a territorial plan well into the next century and we are now matching demand with supply. What we need is community consensus about where we should do the reclamation and so on," he said.
